summary: Iter 86 — 5 new sport pipeline templates (Triathlon 92, Nuoto 77, Ciclismo 77, MTB 76, Trail 93) seeded idempotently alongside Running (114) and Evento generico (32). Backend fully verified via 22-test pytest suite — all pass. SA /piattaforma/modelli-pipeline UI renders 7 cards A-Z with correct task counts; delete button correctly disabled for in-use templates. Event pipeline chooser preselects suggested template based on tipologia, 'Consigliato' badge wired via pipeline-tpl-suggested-{key}. Suggested resolution verified for all 6 tipologie (Triathlon, Nuoto, Ciclismo, Mountain Bike, Trail Running, Running). Pipeline generate from triathlon template produces 92 tasks with scadenza = event_date + giorni_offset (sample dates validated). Non-regression: other orgs' pipelines unchanged. 'Mountain Bike' confirmed in STD_TIPOLOGIE on frontend Events.jsx.

issues: Iubenda cookie banner at bottom can intercept clicks on pipeline-create-cta — not a product bug, same as iter85.

critical_code_review_comments: pipeline_seed_sports.suggest_template matches 'ciclismo' only after excluding 'ciclismo_strada' iteration — intentional to allow 'mountain bike' (contains 'bike' not 'ciclismo') to take precedence; works but ordering is implicit. Consider explicit ordering list for maintainability.

_ensure_pipeline_templates relies on in-process global _pipeline_templates_seeded flag — after a backend restart the first request re-checks DB (idempotent via find_one on key). Confirmed stable: counts unchanged across repeated calls.

platform_pipeline_template_delete returns 409 with Italian detail only when event_pipelines references template_key — correct; frontend already disables the button via in_use flag, so 409 only hits on race conditions.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — chooser preselection/switching/template cards and SA list verified; task-generate click in preview was intermittently intercepted by Iubenda banner but backend generation flow fully covered by pytest (92 tasks + scadenza offset).
